title: AI chat demo
summary: A chat product demo: a prompt is typed, the answer streams in, and one key part is called out.
structure: prompt types in the composer, bubble flies up on a spring, answer streams in chunks, corner marks and a label call out one key phrase, the screen holds

inputs.label: Greeting
inputs.default: What do you want to work out?

inputs.label: Prompt that is typed
inputs.default: Save for a €30k car in 2 years?

inputs.label: Chat name in the sidebar after the answer
Answer heading
inputs.where: BLOCKS h2 in the script, world chat

inputs.label: Answer line 1
inputs.default: Divide the price by the months: €30,000 ÷ 24.
inputs.where: BLOCKS first p in the script, world chat

inputs.label: Answer line with the key part (the part in double stars is called out)
inputs.default: You need to save **€1,250 a month**
inputs.where: BLOCKS second p in the script, world chat

inputs.label: Answer bullet
inputs.default: A 4% savings account trims that to about €1,200.
inputs.where: BLOCKS li in the script, world chat

inputs.label: Call-out label
inputs.where: CALLOUT in the script, world chat

inputs.label: Footnote
inputs.default: Lumen can make mistakes. Check important numbers.
